content:
The **Commander's Charge** is a unique Revolutionary Sword in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

It was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Team Up" in Survival mode from May 14 to May 20, 2019. The weapon was then made available again from August 6 to August 13, 2019.

The weapon comes with the following Legendary Weapon Mods pre-attached:

| **Upgrade** | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Mod | Description | Naming | Effects | | | | | Plan | Components | Form ID | | 
| No upgrade | | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | Steel x3 | – | | 
| Electrified | Adds electrical damage. | Electrified | – | ? | – | ? | ? | – | Adhesive x1 Aluminum x1 Circuitry x1 Rubber x1 | 0013B01F | | 
| Serrated Blade | Targets bleed. Exceptional damage. | Serrated | – | ? | – | ? | ? | – | Adhesive x1 Oil x1 Steel x3 | 00178EB0 | |
